# Practice as algorithm

> Every practice of the AI-augmented method read as an algorithm for a named problem: one page per practice with the problem class, the best-known algorithm and its reference implementation, the gap and the change proposed, in a table a program checks. Scope only; the review is not started.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Practice as algorithm](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-practice/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-practice/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-practice/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics/standard.md): the reader-ergonomics card this repository obeys
